>>

> Bob,

Bob?


> 	Only workaround is to let the dialog open, then while you are still 
> in the table, click the X to close the dialog and it will remain closed while 
> you are in the document from then on unless you call it back up. Same for the 
> other dialogs. But this is required each time you open the document. My 
> letterhead is a table -- I hate it too.

Doesn't work. There are several tables in my documents: if you close it in 
one that way, it pops back in when I get to the next table.

The only method that seems to work is to cycle through all the tables in 
the document, and close the popup in /view/tools/table. Every one of them.
